author: Legoche
body:
In games, whenever somebody gets a shot on another player from 50 blocks away or more, it announces a message in chat like:

'legoche just got a longshot on bob of 76.34 blocks!'

Also, when a player kills a player from 50 or more blocks away the message is clearer in chat and more bold.
